info.title: Runframe V1 API
info.description: The Runframe direct customer API for incident management, on-call scheduling, and postmortems.

get.summary: Verify API key and return scopes

get.description: Returns incidents that are still in progress by default. To include resolved or closed incidents, pass explicit status filters.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Only incidents created at or after this timestamp

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Only incidents created at or before this timestamp

parameters.name: resolved_after
parameters.description: Only incidents resolved at or after this timestamp

parameters.name: resolved_before
parameters.description: Only incidents resolved at or before this timestamp

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key for replay-safe creates. Same key + same payload replays the original response. Same key + different payload returns 409. A duplicate request sent while the original request is still in progress also returns 409.

service_ids.description: Public service keys (e.g. svc_K7M4Q9TZ2H). Use GET /api/v1/services to discover available keys.

201.description: Incident created. Returns the incident snapshot at creation time. Post-create automation such as assignment and notifications may complete asynchronously, so assigned_to and team may not yet reflect final post-create state.

409.description: Idempotency conflict: payload mismatch or duplicate request still in progress

500.description: Server-side configuration error, including incomplete SLA configuration for the requested severity

error.message: SLA settings are invalid for severity SEV2. Update these settings in Settings -> Severities & SLA.
error.user_message: An internal error occurred. Please try again.

patch.description: Field updates only. For status changes use POST /api/v1/incidents/{id}/status.

assigned_to.description: Email address of engineer to assign

post.description: A deliberate action endpoint separate from status transitions. Auto-assigns, stamps acknowledgement time, and resolves the acknowledge SLA.
Canonical status transition endpoint. Resolve, close, investigate, and monitor all flow through here. For acknowledging, use POST /api/v1/incidents/{id}/acknowledge instead.

status.description: Target canonical status name returned by the incident `status` field

400.description: Invalid status or transition not allowed

post.summary: Page a specific person about an incident
post.description: Sends a real notification. Urgency is derived from incident severity automatically.

email.description: Customer-facing identifier for the person to page

200.description: At least one requested channel sent successfully. Response includes per-channel delivery results.

409.description: Delivery failed for all requested channels because the user does not have the required contact details

502.description: Delivery failed for all requested channels because the notification provider could not deliver the message
